intro: The China business visa (M visa) is for commercial trips such as meetings, trade fairs, factory and supplier visits, and negotiating contracts. British passport holders can currently make short business trips visa-free, so you need an M visa if your stay is longer, you need multiple entries over a longer period, or you travel on another passport.
title: China Business Visa (M Visa) from the UK | UVS
description: China business visa help for UK residents: meetings, trade fairs and supplier visits. Invitation letter, forms and visa centre appointment.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for a short business trip?
faqs.a: If you travel on a British passport, short business trips are currently visa-free. We check the latest rules for your dates and passport before you book.

faqs.q: Can I get a multiple-entry visa?
faqs.a: Often, yes, especially if you have visited China before. Tell us how often you travel and we will advise on the best visa to request.

faqs.q: Do I need to attend the visa centre?
faqs.a: Yes. Most applicants give fingerprints in person at a Chinese Visa Application Service Centre. We book the appointment and prepare everything you take with you.
